issues.desc: CHK-001/CHK-003 depend on the existing ProofStory milestone ledger, but relatedDocs omit docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md, the primary source that defines the milestone ledger as an intent-coverage contract rather than execution plan or second storage. Add that doc before DEV or make PLAN explicitly read it so milestone_status does not introduce new subObjective/storage semantics.
